title: RowListResponse
description: Response body for GET /api/data-sources/:id/rows (HEL-1121 design.md D2/D4). `rows` reuses the EXISTING RowResponseRow shape verbatim, ordered by ascending `seq`. `nextCursor` is genuinely absent from the wire body -- never a JSON `null` -- when no further rows remain (spray-json omits `Option = None` fields).
